visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-angle static shot reveals a white table surface. On the left is a white coffee cup with golden patterns filled with foamy latte. Centrally placed is a desk calendar for May 2025. A pink planner and a sheet of chili-themed stickers lie to the right. Bright natural light comes from the left. (2) A hand with silver glitter nails enters the frame and lifts the pink 2025 planner to show its front cover. The background changes to a bright, modern office with glass windows and outdoor greenery visible. The person wearing a black sleeve is holding the planner firmly. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of the calendar pages. A finger flips through months like April and July, pointing at cute chili stickers applied to specific dates. Each sticker shows a red chili character with different facial expressions. The lighting remains bright and even throughout. (4) A hand holds up a small plush chili pendant with a green cap and black sunglasses. The scene quickly cuts to the same pendant hanging from the gold chain of a white Miu Miu handbag. The bag is held up against a blurred indoor studio background. (5) A very large, oversized red chili plush pillow sits on a white fabric sofa. A hand reaches out to touch, pat, and squeeze the pillow, highlighting its soft, squishy texture. The pillow features a stitched yellow smile and large black sunglasses as its face. (6) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black beanie and round glasses, appears in a medium shot. She holds a white sign shaped like a speech bubble with text and a chili icon. She looks at the camera with a friendly smile in a sunlit office.
